name: btc-chat-payment-request-demo
capture: Actual Android app, real empty Testnet wallet and real generated payment request. Synthetic offline contact.
demonstrated_actions: Open Request via chat in Q-Vault
View locally saved request in chat
limits: No mainnet wallet or funds used
Recipient is a synthetic offline contact; request saved locally, not delivered to a second device
No Bitcoin transaction signed or broadcast
Fiat amount is the estimate shown by the app during recording
editing: Navigation and waiting time removed. Original playback speed retained. Android status bar replaced with Testnet demo scene labels.

scenes.label: TESTNET DEMO // Q-VAULT TO CHAT
scenes.en: Open Request via chat from the Bitcoin vault. This wallet uses Testnet and has no funds.
scenes.it: Apri Richiedi via chat dal portafoglio Bitcoin. Il wallet usa Testnet e non contiene fondi.

scenes.label: TESTNET DEMO // AMOUNT AND MEMO
scenes.en: Enter 25,000 sats and a memo. The app also shows the amount in BTC and a fiat estimate.
scenes.it: Inserisci 25.000 satoshi e una causale. L’app mostra anche l’importo in BTC e una stima in valuta.

scenes.label: TESTNET DEMO // REVIEW AND SHARE REQUEST
scenes.en: Review the amount, memo and Testnet receiving address, then choose Send request.
scenes.it: Controlla importo, causale e indirizzo di ricezione Testnet, poi scegli Invia richiesta.

scenes.label: TESTNET DEMO // SAMPLE CONTACT - OFFLINE
scenes.en: Choose the demo contact. With this peer offline, the request is saved locally in the conversation.
scenes.it: Scegli il contatto demo. Poiché il peer è offline, la richiesta viene salvata localmente nella conversazione.

scenes.label: TESTNET DEMO // AWAITING PAYMENT
scenes.en: The chat card shows 0.00025000 BTC, 25,000 sats, the memo and Awaiting payment.
scenes.it: La scheda in chat mostra 0,00025000 BTC, 25.000 satoshi, la causale e In attesa di pagamento.

scenes.label: TESTNET DEMO // PAYMENT DETAILS
scenes.en: Payment details keep the network, receiving address, amount and memo together.
scenes.it: I dettagli riuniscono rete, indirizzo di ricezione, importo e causale.

scenes.label: TESTNET DEMO // REQUEST CREATED - NO PAYMENT
scenes.en: Request created. No Bitcoin payment is signed or broadcast in this demo.
scenes.it: Richiesta creata. In questa demo non viene firmato né trasmesso alcun pagamento Bitcoin.
